title: Energising Shell - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Energising Shell in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: East of Stone Wave Cliffs Cave in a Paint Break

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Energising Shell is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Give 2 AP on applying Shell.

sections.title: How to Get Energising Shell
sections.content: Location: East of Stone Wave Cliffs Cave in a Paint Break.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
